source.quote: Roon forum: « Gustard has made updated firmware for their A26 DAC and now the DSD Direct mode works as expected » ; « I especially liked ASDM7EC-light (512+fs) at DSD512 » ; Audiophile Style: Gustard X30 « DSD512 with default filters and ASDM7EC-fast » ; chip: the reference's author, « Gustard figured out how to configure AK4191+AK4499EX to work correctly in DSD Direct mode » ; two AK4499EX converters with one AK4191 modulator, per Linsoul, Apos, HiFiGo and Head-Fi listings read 2026-11-20. AKM.
